topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I can’t shake the thought that this whole situation could have been avoided. Looking back, I realize I should have spent more time on my own research, double-checked my citations, made sure everything was in order. Now, with the accusations flying, it’s hard to focus. I know the professor values originality and integrity, and I can only imagine how disappointed they must be. I want to clear things up, explain that it wasn’t my intention to take credit for someone else’s work. Maybe if I reach out, show them the drafts, the notes, they might see that I’ve made a genuine effort. I just hope it’s not too late to make things right.
